description: Tasks are started inside a block and cannot outlive it: the block ends only when all of them are done.
An async context manager that starts tasks with `create_task`, waits for them on exit and cancels the rest on the first failure.
One exception holding several (`.exceptions`). A task group raises one even for a single failure.
Matches exceptions inside a group; each clause receives the matching subgroup and the rest is re-raised.
When a task in a group fails, the other tasks receive `CancelledError`, which `gather` never does.
